title: JSFL: doc.moveSelectionBy and doc.scaleSelection implementations
description:
Add two real implementations to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. doc.moveSelectionBy(delta: {x: number, y: number}): void
   - Iterate state.doc.selection (array of selected displayObject ids)
   - For each selected object, update its x and y by adding delta.x and delta.y
   - Look at how doc.selection getter works and how setFrameProperty or similar updates displayObject properties
   - Add to JsflDocument interface and makeDocumentProxy

2. doc.scaleSelection(xScale: number, yScale: number, whichCorner?: string): void
   - Iterate state.doc.selection
   - For each selected object, multiply its scaleX by xScale and scaleY by yScale
   - whichCorner can be ignored for now (stub that param)
   - Add to JsflDocument interface and makeDocumentProxy

Look at how selection is accessed in the existing selection getter (around line 1169-1195) to understand how to iterate and mutate selected display objects.
